title: Zora TranscriptNFT
tagline: ZoraNft is a transcript solution that helps students in any form generate their transcript
description: Zora TranscriptNft is a transcript solution that helps students in any form generate their transcript and use this across all and various educational platforms, with this transcript students can apply to scholarships and academic openings. This can not be limited to only academic resources. This is equally verifiable onchain to weed out any discrepancies
how_its_made:
It is a basic project nftstorage was used in uploading the image of the transcript to ipfs in order to get access to it and save it on-chain.
IPFS and a basic smart contract is used to facilitate this functionality, in a real case scenario a back end from the school or institution is where the information is gotten from
